title: spergularia × pseudoazorica
intro: Spergularia × pseudoazorica, commonly known as Azorella pseudoazorica or False Azorella, is a rare and hybrid plant species in the Caryophyllaceae family. It is native to the Azores and has been used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Spergularia × pseudoazorica include its potential to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and show promise in the treatment of certain skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been reported to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
